Faghiu is a flower of the frigid mountains of north-western Endor. It is of legendary rarity, making any attempt to find it exceptionally uncertain.

Prepared as an infusion or decoction, it yields a potion that compels the recipient to love or serve the person who administered it for 1–100 days. The effect has an explicit limit: it will not induce the victim to willingly harm themself. No addiction factor is recorded in the catalogue.
